newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-RAIN HITS SRI LANKA-NZ ONE-DAYER.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-RAIN HITS SRI LANKA-NZ ONE-DAYER.

text.p: Heavy rain delayed the start of play in the one-day international between Sri Lanka and New Zealand at Eden Park on Saturday.
The umpires were to decide at 11.30 a.m. (2330 GMT) whether there was any chance of play.
If not, the teams will return to the ground on Sunday to play the first match in the scheduled three-game series.
The chances of play on Saturday looked very slim with rain saturating the ground in the early morning.
